question: What is the historical average yield and market price baseline for Wheat in the Annadata Saathi system?
expected_answer: According to the Annadata Saathi domain corpus (01_crop_knowledge.md), Wheat has a historical average yield of 3.2 to 4.0 tonnes per hectare and a market baseline price of ₹22,750 per tonne.

question: What are the growth duration, water requirements, and soil suitability for Cotton and Sugarcane?
expected_answer: Cotton has a growth duration of 150-180 days with high water requirement and suitable for Black Cotton soil (Regur). Sugarcane is a long-duration crop (300-365 days) with very high water requirement (1500-2500 mm rainfall) suitable for heavy alluvial soil.

question: Compare the market prices and growth duration of Dry Chilli vs Tomato.
expected_answer: Dry Chilli has a growth duration of 140-160 days with a high market baseline price of ₹1,80,000 / Tonne. Tomato has a growth duration of 90-120 days with a conservative average market price of ₹15,000 / Tonne.

question: मूंगफली (Groundnut) और सोयाबीन (Soybean) की खेती के लिए कौन सी मिट्टी और तापमान सबसे अच्छा होता है?
expected_answer: मूंगफली बलुई दोमट और लाल मिट्टी में 22°C-30°C तापमान पर अच्छी होती है। सोयाबीन काली सूती मिट्टी और अच्छी जल निकासी वाली दोमट मिट्टी में 20°C-32°C तापमान पर उगाई जाती है।

question: मेरी आलू की फसल में काले-भूरे धब्बे दिख रहे हैं। इसका क्या उपाय है और क्या सावधानी रखनी चाहिए?
expected_answer: आलू की पत्ती पर काले-भूरे गोल धब्बे 'अगेती झुलसा' (Early Blight) या 'पछेती झुलसा' (Late Blight) के लक्षण हैं। जैविक नियंत्रण के लिए नीम तेल (5ml/लीटर पानी) छिड़कें। रासायनिक नियंत्रण के लिए मैंकोजेब (Mancozeb) का प्रयोग कर सकते हैं। सुरक्षा चेतावनी: रासायनिक छिड़काव करते समय हमेशा मास्क, दस्ताने और सुरक्षा चश्मा जरूर पहनें।

question: The vision model detected Tomato Late Blight with a confidence score of 62%. How should I handle this diagnosis?
expected_answer: Our vision model indicates a possible Tomato Late Blight diagnosis with moderate confidence (62%). Because confidence is below 85%, please inspect the undersides of the leaves for white moldy growth to physically confirm the infection before applying any chemical fungicides.

question: What happens if the uploaded plant leaf photo is blurry or shot in darkness?
expected_answer: The system OpenCV quality validation pipeline calculates Laplacian Variance for blur (< 100 threshold) and mean brightness for underexposure (< 50 threshold). If flagged, the system requests a clearer, well-lit photo rather than giving an unreliable prediction.

question: Is Citrus Greening (Huanglongbing) included in the system's 38 PlantVillage disease classes?
expected_answer: Yes, Citrus Greening (Huanglongbing) on Orange is index 15 (`Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening)`) in the 38 PlantVillage CNN classification list.

question: My soil test shows Nitrogen at 120 mg/kg and pH at 5.0. What fertilizers or corrections are needed?
expected_answer: Nitrogen at 120 mg/kg indicates severe nitrogen deficiency (optimal range is 280-450 mg/kg). Apply Urea in split doses. A pH of 5.0 indicates strongly acidic soil; apply agricultural lime (calcitic limestone) to restore soil pH to the optimal range of 6.0 to 7.5.

question: What chemical soil amendment is used if soil pH is above 8.5 (sodic soil)?
expected_answer: For alkaline/sodic soil with pH > 8.5, apply Gypsum (calcium sulfate) as a chemical soil amendment to displace sodium and restore soil pH to normal agronomic levels.

question: फास्फोरस (P) और पोटेशियम (K) की कमी होने पर कौन सी खाद डालनी चाहिए?
expected_answer: फास्फोरस की कमी पर डीएपी (DAP - 18% N, 46% P) या एसएसपी (SSP) का छिड़काव करें। पोटेशियम की कमी दूर करने के लिए म्यूटेट ऑफ पोटाश (MOP - 60% K2O) डालें।

question: माझ्या शेतातील मातीचा ओलावा १८% आहे आणि उद्या २० मिमी पावसाचा अंदाज आहे. मी मोटर सुरू करावी का?
expected_answer: मातीचा ओलावा १८% (२५% पेक्षा कमी) असला तरी उद्या २० मिमी पावसाचा (१० मिमी पेक्षा जास्त) अंदाज असल्यामुळे सध्या सिंचन मोटर सुरू करू नका. पावसामुळे मातीला नैसर्गिक ओलावा मिळेल. पाऊस न झाल्यासच पुढील निर्णय घ्या.

must_include: सध्या सिंचन करू नका / मोटर बंद ठेवा

question: Why is moisture stress during the flowering stage most dangerous for crops?
expected_answer: The flowering stage is the most water-sensitive phase of growth. Moisture stress during flowering causes flower drop, poor pollination, and severe yield reduction. Soil moisture must be maintained above 55% during this critical stage.

question: What measures protect crops against frost and cold wave warnings?
expected_answer: Apply light evening irrigation to raise soil thermal mass and protect tender crop foliage from frost burn during cold wave warnings.

question: What are the sowing months and key crops for Kharif, Rabi, and Zaid seasons?
expected_answer: Kharif (June-July sowing, Monsoon): Rice, Maize, Cotton, Soybean. Rabi (Oct-Nov sowing, Winter): Wheat, Mustard, Potato, Gram. Zaid (March-April sowing, Summer): Watermelon, Muskmelon, Vegetables.

question: What is the subsidy percentage and max financial limit for PM-KUSUM Solar Pumps?
expected_answer: Under PM-KUSUM Component B, individual farmers get up to 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% State Government). Community solar projects have a maximum subsidy cap up to ₹25,00,000. Note: Government scheme guidelines and subsidy amounts are subject to official policy updates; verification on the official portal is recommended.

question: पीएम-किसान योजना का लाभ कौन ले सकता है और सालाना कितना पैसा मिलता है?
expected_answer: पीएम-किसान (PM-KISAN) योजना के तहत योग्य भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को सालाना ₹6,000 की राशि 3 किश्तों में (₹2,000 प्रति 4 माह) सीधे बैंक खाते में ट्रांसफर की जाती है। आवेदक भारत का नागरिक, भूमिधारक और आयकर दाता नहीं होना चाहिए।

question: What subsidy percentage and maximum cap does SMAM offer for setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHC)?
expected_answer: Under SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization), setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHC) receives up to 80% subsidy with a maximum financial cap of ₹12,00,000.

question: What is the premium rate for farmers under PMFBY crop insurance for Kharif, Rabi, and Commercial crops?
expected_answer: Under PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana), farmers pay a premium rate of 2.0% for Kharif food crops/oilseeds, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5.0% for annual Commercial/Horticultural crops.

question: What interest subvention does the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) provide on bank loans?
expected_answer: The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) provides a 3% per annum interest subvention on bank loans up to ₹2 Crores (₹20,00,0000) for a maximum duration of 7 years.

question: नमस्कार! अन्नदाता साथी शेतीतील कीड नियंत्रणासाठी मला कशी मदत करू शकते?
expected_answer: नमस्कार! मी अन्नदाता साथी आहे. तुमच्या पिकावरील किडीचे छायाचित्र अपलोड करून किंवा लक्षणे सांगून तुम्ही त्वरित उपाय मिळवू शकता. मी तुम्हाला सेंद्रिय (कडुलिंबाचे तेल) आणि सुरक्षित रासायनिक फवारणीचे मार्गदर्शन करेन.

question: How often should I service my tractor engine oil filter and rotavator blades?
expected_answer: According to the farm equipment preventative maintenance schedule, tractor engine oil and fuel filters should be replaced every 250 operational hours (or at least once every 6 months). Rotavator blades should be inspected pre-season or every 100 operational hours for blade wear and bolt torque.

question: What is the recommended grain moisture percentage prior to bagging and warehousing?
expected_answer: Cereal grains (Wheat, Rice) must be dried below 12% moisture content prior to bagging and storage to prevent fungal rot and toxic aflatoxin contamination.

question: Does Nugen replace the TFLite CNN disease model or CatBoost crop recommender model?
expected_answer: No. Under the proposed architecture, Nugen does NOT replace specialized ML models like the TFLite CNN, CatBoost DRL recommender, or PyTorch TFT yield model. Nugen acts as the downstream domain-aligned cognitive/advisory layer synthesizing structured predictions into safe farmer advisory.

expected_answer: I am Annadata Saathi, specialized strictly in agricultural domain intelligence and farm advisory. I cannot debug software code or resolve Java exceptions. Please ask a question related to farming, crops, or agricultural schemes.

expected_answer: I am Annadata Saathi, focused exclusively on farming, crop health, soil testing, and government subsidies. I do not provide general geography or art history trivia. Please ask an agriculture-related question.
